senses.gloss:
खिद् खिद्, i. 6, खिन्द, Par.; i. 4, and ii. 7, खिनद्, खिन्द्, Ātm. (i. 4, also Par. Bhāg. P. 3, 4, 16).
 1. To be afflicted, Rām. 2, 39, 7.
 2. To be subdued, Hit. ii. d. 134.
 3. To despair, Rām. 3, 49, 57.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. खिन्न,
 1. Tired, Man. 7, 141.
 2. Exhausted, Bhartṛ. 1, 47.
 3. Desponding, Rām. 3, 69, 5.
 --Caus. To distress, Mṛcch. 143, 14.
 खेदित, Relaxed, Rām. 5, 13, 47.
 --With the prep. परि परि, To be afflicted, Bhāg. P. 3, 9, 28 (i. 4, Par.).
 परिखिन्न, Tired, Rām. 4, 51, 3.
 --Caus. To afflict, Bhāg. P. 1, 17, 7.
 --Cf. probably κίνδυνος.
